description.en-US: The Most Rev. Dr James Butler's Catechism (Ireland, 1775), revised, enlarged and improved and recommended by the four Roman Catholic Archbishops of Ireland as a general catechism: thirty short lessons of questions and answers on God, creation, the Creed, the commandments, the sacraments, the last things and the general judgment, with Bishop Milner's Scriptural Catechism and an appendix.
description.pt-BR: O Catecismo do Rev.mo Dr. James Butler (Irlanda, 1775), revisto, ampliado, melhorado e recomendado pelos quatro arcebispos católicos da Irlanda como catecismo geral: trinta lições breves de perguntas e respostas sobre Deus, a criação, o Credo, os mandamentos, os sacramentos, as últimas coisas e o juízo final, com o Catecismo Bíblico do bispo Milner e um apêndice.

sources.description: Most Rev. Doctor James Butler's Catechism, revised, enlarged, improved and recommended by the four R. C. Archbishops of Ireland as a general catechism, to which is added the Scriptural Catechism by Bishop Milner (New York: D. & J. Sadlier), via the archive.org OCR text. Tier A: Butler's text is of 1775 and this printing is of the nineteenth century. Uncorrected OCR beyond rules; the lesson tablets at the end are left out.
